repos.description: Webhook delivery for Fieldnote. Signs each attempt, retries with a budget, and records the outcome the partner can replay.
The partner console. Shows delivery attempts, signatures, and the replay button Northwind asked for.
The package partners import. Retries must send the original event id and the signature from the first attempt.
Alerts and the dead-letter queue. Pages Jonah when a delivery exhausts its retry budget overnight.

skills.name: Relay incident note
skills.description: How Mira writes a delivery incident so Jonah and Priya can both read it.
skills.body: Lead with the event id, the partner, and whether the attempt was signed. Say how many tries ran and where the last one stopped. Do not invent a root cause. If the signature window is the suspect, say the timestamps and who still owes the NTP note. Close with the one next check, not a list of maybes.

skills.name: Webhook signature review
skills.description: What to look for before accepting a change to Relay's signer.
skills.body: A replay must reuse the original signature. Reject a diff that signs again inside the retry loop. The timestamp in the signature is the first attempt, not the latest one. Tests should cover a failed partner response and a clock that is 20 seconds ahead.

skills.name: Partner status update
skills.description: Short note to a design partner when a delivery change is ready to try.
skills.body: Name the event they can replay, the window they should expect, and what will look different in the console. Skip internal branch names. Offer a time the same day if something fails verification.

diagram.title: Relay delivery path
diagram.source:
title Relay delivery path
direction right

node ingress "Public ingress" shape rectangle
node sign "Sign once" shape rectangle
node queue "Delivery queue" shape rectangle
node worker "Retry worker" shape rectangle
node partner "Northwind endpoint" shape rectangle
node dead "Dead letter" shape rectangle

edge ingress > sign : accept event
edge sign > queue : store signature
edge queue > worker
edge worker > partner : signed attempt
edge worker > dead : budget spent

messages.content: Write the retry budget Jonah can forward to Priya. Eight tries, cap the wait at 15 minutes.

Relay tries a delivery eight times. The wait grows each time and never exceeds 15 minutes. After the eighth miss the event goes to the dead letter list, still under the original attempt id, and the console can replay it.
